svg.aria-label: Proposed conversion routing v2: a layered profiler (3.1A document facts, 3.1B page-image facts, 3.1C probe hooks) feeds a router that sends each page to one of four runways (3.2a docling without OCR, 3.2b docling with OCR, 3.2c docling plus VLM on regions, 3.2d VLM whole page); a gate passes, escalates to 3.2d, or sends to repair; a routing harness measures every step.
svg.font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, Segoe UI, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif
svg.text: rag-search · stage 3 Convert · routing v2 (proposal, nothing built)
When sure, read with docling (with or without OCR). When in doubt, read with the vision model (VLM).
A page of a PDF, or an image file
Office / HTML: docling as a whole · Markdown / text: copied (no change)
3.1 PROFILE · per page, cheapest layer first; the next layer runs only for pages still open
ink the text layer does not explain
only for pages A + B leave open, budgeted
ordered rules, thresholds in one versioned table · capabilities = what this machine can run (VLM, OCR engines and scripts)
scans: clean ones try 3.2b first, hard ones (photo, ruled table, poor) go to 3.2d · blank pages are not read
3.3 GATE v2 · graded and located verdict per page
today: coverage, script, docling grade, table shape, resolution, loops, running balance, totals
new: expected amount of text · word plausibility per script · column types · reader confidence · layer agreement
each runway is allowed only where the gate can catch its typical failure
Qwen3-VL 8B: crop and re-read suspect cells,
re-read the whole page; kept only if the gate
tables across pages joined, headers repeated
then 4 Chunk -> 5 Embed -> 6 Write -> 7 Merge -> 8 Publish
kept and flagged (search marks it low-confidence)
last resort when the VLM is unavailable or fails: decided in R7
(a, b per OCR engine, c, d)
only where it shows a gain
Phases: R0a trace mining -> R0 harness -> R2 3.2b first-class (with expected-size and plausibility checks) | R1 profiler A+B alongside
-> R3 rest of gate v2 -> R4 router in shadow -> R5 switch on -> R6 first probes -> R7 decisions: fallback policy, non-Mac models.
